chapterInfo.content:
21
Babel, Edom ne Arabia ho atemmusɛm
1 # Yes 13; 14 Mpoano serɛ ho atemmusɛm nie:
Sɛdeɛ ahum tutu firi Negeb ba no,
saa ara na ɛfiri serɛ soɔ,
ɛfiri asase a ɛso yɛ hu so ba.
2Anisoadehunu a ɛyɛ den na wɔayi akyerɛ me:
Ɔfomfafoɔ refom fa,
ɔsɛefoɔ resɛesɛe.
O Elam, foro bra!
O Media, bɛka no hyɛ mu!
Mɛma n’apinisie nyinaa
to atwa.
3Enti m’asene mu ka me dwɛɛdwɛɛ,
ɛkyem aka me
sɛ ɔwofoɔ kyem;
yea a ɛyɛ me nti, mente asɛm,
me ho a ɛyera me nti, menhunu adeɛ,
4m’akoma ka paripari, ehu ama mayɛ titiritii,
ama anwummerɛ hann a mehwehwɛeɛ no
adane me ahopopoɔ.
5Wɔto pono no,
wɔsesɛ kuntu akɛtɛ,
wɔdidi na wɔnom.
O Asafohene, monsɔre!
Monsra akyɛm ho ngo.
6Na deɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me nie:
Kɔ, fa ɔwɛmfoɔ
kɔgyina hɔ, deɛ ɔbɛhunu no, ma ɔnka.
7Sɛ ɔhunu nteaseɛnam, apɔnkɔsotefoɔ baanu baanu,
mfunumu-so-tenafoɔ ne nyoma-so-tenafoɔ;
na ɔwɛn n’aso
wɛn pa ara.
8 # Hab 2.1 Na ɔteaa mu sɛ gyata sɛ:
O AWURADE, megyina awɛneeɛ ha ara
adekyeeɛ daa,
na megyina m’ahwɛeɛ ara
anadwo nyinaa,
9 # Adi 18.2 na hwɛ, nteaseɛnam ne nnipa,
apɔnkɔsotefoɔ baanu baanu na wɔreba yi.
Na ɔgyee so sɛ:
Ahweaseɛ oo! Babel ahwe ase!
Na n’anyame ahoni nyinaa,
wɔabubu agu fam.
10M’adeɛ a wɔaporeɛ ne m’ayuporeeɛ ase ba!
Deɛ mate no asafo AWURADE,
Israel Nyankopɔn, anomu no, na maka makyerɛ woɔ yi.
Duma a ɛne Edom ho atemmusɛm
11 # Yer 49.7; Deut 2.5 Duma ho atemmusɛm nie:
Obi bɔn me firi Seir sɛ:
Ɔwɛmfoɔ, anadwo mu dasuo bɛn nie?
Ɔwɛmfoɔ, anadwo mu dasuo bɛn nie?
12Ɔwɛmfoɔ no se:
Adeɛ rekye, na adesaeɛ nso reba;
sɛ mobɛbisa a, mommisa, monsane mmra.
Arabia ho atemmusɛm
13Arabia ho atemmusɛm nie:
Dedanim akwantemfoɔ asafo,
Arabia kwaeɛ mu na mobɛsoɛ.
14Momfa nsuo mmɛhyia wɔn a sukɔm de wɔn,
Tema asase sofoɔ,
momfa paanoo mmɛhyia adwanefoɔ;
15ɛfiri sɛ mfena ano na wɔredwane,
afena a wɔatwe
ne tadua a wɔapono
ne ɔko denden ano.
16 # Yes 16.14 Na deɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me nie: Ɛha afe sɛ ɔpaani mfeɛ#21.16 ƆPAANI MFEƐ: Yei hyɛ aseɛ firi berɛ a wɔfaa no no, de kɔsi berɛ a ɔde wiee ne paadie no. teɛ no, na Kedar animuonyam nyinaa asa koraa, 17na Kedar mma mu nnɔmmarima tadua dodoɔ nkaeɛ no bɛsua, ɛfiri sɛ Israel Nyankopɔn na aka.

pageProps.chapterText:
Mpoano serɛ ho atemmusɛm nie:
Sɛdeɛ ahum tutu firi Negeb ba no,
saa ara na ɛfiri serɛ soɔ,
ɛfiri asase a ɛso yɛ hu so ba.
Anisoadehunu a ɛyɛ den na wɔayi akyerɛ me:
Ɔfomfafoɔ refom fa,
ɔsɛefoɔ resɛesɛe.
O Elam, foro bra!
O Media, bɛka no hyɛ mu!
Mɛma n’apinisie nyinaa
to atwa.
Enti m’asene mu ka me dwɛɛdwɛɛ,
ɛkyem aka me
sɛ ɔwofoɔ kyem;
yea a ɛyɛ me nti, mente asɛm,
me ho a ɛyera me nti, menhunu adeɛ,
m’akoma ka paripari, ehu ama mayɛ titiritii,
ama anwummerɛ hann a mehwehwɛeɛ no
adane me ahopopoɔ.
Wɔto pono no,
wɔsesɛ kuntu akɛtɛ,
wɔdidi na wɔnom.
O Asafohene, monsɔre!
Monsra akyɛm ho ngo.
Na deɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me nie:
Kɔ, fa ɔwɛmfoɔ
kɔgyina hɔ, deɛ ɔbɛhunu no, ma ɔnka.
Sɛ ɔhunu nteaseɛnam, apɔnkɔsotefoɔ baanu baanu,
mfunumu-so-tenafoɔ ne nyoma-so-tenafoɔ;
na ɔwɛn n’aso
wɛn pa ara.
Na ɔteaa mu sɛ gyata sɛ:
O AWURADE, megyina awɛneeɛ ha ara
adekyeeɛ daa,
na megyina m’ahwɛeɛ ara
anadwo nyinaa,
na hwɛ, nteaseɛnam ne nnipa,
apɔnkɔsotefoɔ baanu baanu na wɔreba yi.
Na ɔgyee so sɛ:
Ahweaseɛ oo! Babel ahwe ase!
Na n’anyame ahoni nyinaa,
wɔabubu agu fam.
M’adeɛ a wɔaporeɛ ne m’ayuporeeɛ ase ba!
Deɛ mate no asafo AWURADE,
Israel Nyankopɔn, anomu no, na maka makyerɛ woɔ yi.

Duma ho atemmusɛm nie:
Obi bɔn me firi Seir sɛ:
Ɔwɛmfoɔ, anadwo mu dasuo bɛn nie?
Ɔwɛmfoɔ, anadwo mu dasuo bɛn nie?
Ɔwɛmfoɔ no se:
Adeɛ rekye, na adesaeɛ nso reba;
sɛ mobɛbisa a, mommisa, monsane mmra.

Arabia ho atemmusɛm nie:
Dedanim akwantemfoɔ asafo,
Arabia kwaeɛ mu na mobɛsoɛ.
Momfa nsuo mmɛhyia wɔn a sukɔm de wɔn,
Tema asase sofoɔ,
momfa paanoo mmɛhyia adwanefoɔ;
ɛfiri sɛ mfena ano na wɔredwane,
afena a wɔatwe
ne tadua a wɔapono
ne ɔko denden ano.
Na deɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me nie: Ɛha afe sɛ ɔpaani mfeɛ teɛ no, na Kedar animuonyam nyinaa asa koraa, na Kedar mma mu nnɔmmarima tadua dodoɔ nkaeɛ no bɛsua, ɛfiri sɛ Israel Nyankopɔn na aka.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
